author: Aether I
title: CNN-GRU Policy Gradient - Ablation: No Residual Connections
abstract: This submission conducts an ablation study on the CNN-GRU architecture, specifically removing the residual connections within the convolutional feature extraction blocks. The goal is to assess the impact of these connections on the agent's planning capabilities and overall solve rate in the Sokoban environment, using the best hyperparameters from Evaluation ID 28.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from ray import tune
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

BASE_SEED = 42 # For reproducibility

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """
    Define fixed hyperparameters based on the best trial from Evaluation ID 28.
    """
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([0.000259]),  # Fixed to best from Eval ID 28
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.011754]),   # Fixed to best from Eval ID 28
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.573199]),# Fixed to best from Eval ID 28
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([64]),       # Fixed to best from previous trial
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([128]),      # Fixed to best from previous trial
        'gru_features': tune.choice([256])         # Fixed to best from previous trial
    }

class SokobanGRUCNN_NoResidual(nn.Module):
    """CNN with GRU for Sokoban, building on default CNN structure, WITHOUT residual connections."""
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    gru_features: int
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[jnp.ndarray] = None) -> Tuple[jnp.ndarray, jnp.ndarray, jnp.ndarray]:
        """Forward pass through the network."""
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        
        # CNN Feature Extraction (similar to DefaultResidualCNN, but without residuals)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # Second block - NO residual connection
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        # x = x + conv2_in  # Removed residual connection
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # Third block - increase channels
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # Fourth block - NO residual connection
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        # x = x + conv4_in  # Removed residual connection
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # Flatten spatial dimensions for GRU input
        x = x.reshape((batch_size, -1))
        
        # GRU Layer for temporal processing
        # Handle initial RNN state: if None, initialize to zeros
        if rnn_state is None:
            rnn_state = jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.gru_features), dtype=jnp.float32)
        
        # Use nn.RNN with nn.GRUCell instead of non-existent nn.GRU
        gru_cell = nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_features)
        new_rnn_state, gru_out = gru_cell(rnn_state, x)
        
        # Shared MLP backbone after GRU
        x = nn.Dense(features=256)(gru_out)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # Separate heads for policy and value
        policy_hidden = nn.Dense(features=64)(x)
        policy_hidden = nn.relu(policy_hidden)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(features=4)(policy_hidden)
        
        value_hidden = nn.Dense(features=64)(x)
        value_hidden = nn.relu(value_hidden)
        value = nn.Dense(features=1)(value_hidden).squeeze(-1)
        
        return policy_logits, value, new_rnn_state

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Create and return the CNN-GRU network architecture."""
    return SokobanGRUCNN_NoResidual(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        gru_features=hparams['gru_features']
    )

# No override for create_optimizer or training_step; using defaults.
